profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at Gap Inc.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Backend development (Java) on the Cross-Channel Experience team for a suite of iOS applications used by in-store associates to sell inventory. 
•	Developed user interface tests (XCTest) and became familiar with the Coordinator design pattern.  
•	Built a Rails web dashboard that displayed metadata from 600+ international stores to aid the release management team.

positions.title: Graphic Designer and Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Self-taught in graphic design and front-end development allowing for involvement with the entire creative process. 
•	Improved skills through designing and developing personal website.
•	Designed tens of logos, apparel designs, and other graphics for clients. 
•	Grasped the concept of clean and intuitive design.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•     Worked with senior software engineers to develop the company’s flagship software, which integrated satellite capacity management into one system using C# and SQL.
•     Used DevExpress’ platforms to revamp the old UI, and modified SQL scripts to reflect new fields of data added to the interface through use of triggers and stored procedures for multiple Agile cycles. 
•     Achieved an understanding of both the technical and enterprise side of satellite communications.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Major: Computer Engineering, Minor: Computer Science

educations.schoolName: Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology
